source: Meta Ad Library (India, active ads) + the company's own live website

ads.destination: Instagram (instagram.com/ray_on_solar_systems_) with an fb.me 'Get Quote' button
ads.text: Reduce Your Electricity Bills with Solar - 3kW Solar Power System Offer. Get your 3kW solar system at a special price with subsidy and long-term warranty support. (Ad destination links to the company's Instagram profile; the Get Quote button goes to a generic fb.me link.)

ad_library.summary: Ray On Solar Systems is running 1 live ad on Meta (Library ID 1107666674962232, started 13 October 2026) offering a 3kW solar system at a special price with subsidy - and the ad sends the click to Instagram, not to the company's website. The company is based in Visakhapatnam and is advertising into Telangana.

funnel.destination: instagram.com/ray_on_solar_systems_ (ad creative link) and fb.me ('Get Quote')
funnel.meaning: A social profile is not a funnel. There is no lead capture, no quote form and nothing to retarget - and the site's own free-quote form sits unused while the ad pays for clicks.

findings: The live 3kW-offer ad (Library ID 1107666674962232, started 13 October 2026) sends Telugu solar buyers to an Instagram profile - not to rayonsolarsystems.in. A profile has no lead capture, no phone form and nothing to retarget.
The ad's 'Get Quote' button goes to a generic fb.me link - the click never lands on a page that takes a name, a phone number or a bill amount.

The site itself is a clean WordPress build with a free-quote form, on-grid/off-grid rooftop systems, PM Surya Ghar subsidy assistance and a real-time monitoring section - none of it is in the paid path.
Visakhapatnam-based (Ravi Nagar, Naidu Thota, 530029) and advertising into Telangana - no Telangana service-area proof for the buyer the ad is aimed at.
One live ad is the entire paid presence - no second creative, no retargeting, nothing to A/B test.
next_steps: Point the ad at the site's own quote page
The site already has a free-quote form and the PM Surya Ghar subsidy section - sending the 3kW-offer click there instead of Instagram turns the spend into measurable leads.
Or build a dedicated 3kW offer page
A landing page carrying the ad's exact offer - special 3kW price, subsidy, long-term warranty - with name, phone and locality captured before any chat.
A service-area statement and named local installs turn a Visakhapatnam advertiser into a local option for the Telugu buyer.
One ad cannot tell you which message works - a subsidy-focused and an EMI-focused version against each other would.
contact_facts: Ray On Solar Systems - claims 5+ years of technical experience
